value_stream.name: Smart Locker & Automated Parcel Collection Network

fields.Trigger: BOPIS order ready (VS-10); locker compartment available
fields.Volume: ~BOPIS-to-locker orders scaling with adoption (subset of ~25,700 BOPIS orders/month profile §8.2)

Automation Opportunity: - Dimension-to-compartment auto-assignment; pick-task auto-routing; pickup-ready auto-notify
Controls: - CTL-723 (ensure controlled execution — Collection Operations, Replenishment & Access Management (PA-164.2).)
- CTL-723: compartment assigned by item dimensions; staging within BOPIS SLA; availability rebalanced
Cross-references: - links to VS-10 (BOPIS/OMS), VS-05 (inventory), VS-07 (store ops), W4802 (access codes), W4804 (overflow), W4805 (pickup/notify), W4807 (integration)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compartment-mismatch risk**: Wrong-size compartment for the order → can't fit → fallback to counter; mitigated by dimension-based assignment
- **Replenishment-bottleneck risk**: Slow staging → missed pick SLA; mitigated by pick-task prioritization
- **Starvation risk**: Lockers full → BOPIS rerouted to counter → locker underutilized in perception; mitigated by overflow/reclaim (W4804)
System Touchpoints: - OMS/BOPIS (VS-10); locker platform (W4807); inventory (VS-05); store ops (VS-07); notifications (VS-75)

steps.activity: On BOPIS order ready (VS-10), route eligible orders to the locker channel (vs counter pickup): select the right compartment size from the order's item dimensions (W4796 mix), auto-assign an available compartment via the locker/OMS integration (W4807), and generate the pick task for the stock associate

Pick & stage the order into the assigned compartment: scan items into the compartment, lock it, trigger the access-code/QR delivery to the customer (W4802) and the pickup-ready notification (W4805); manage the SLA (profile §8.2 BOPIS pick SLA 4 hrs)

Replenish & rebalance compartments continuously: free compartments on pickup (W4805), re-assign overflow (W4804), and maintain availability for peak BOPIS windows; coordinate with the counter-pickup fallback when lockers are full

fields.Trigger: Order staged in a compartment (W4801); returns drop-off (W4803); 3P parcel (W4799)

Automation Opportunity: - Auto PIN/QR generation + delivery; pickup-authentication auto-confirm → OMS/inventory update; fraud-pattern detection (VS-125)
Controls: - CTL-723 (ensure controlled execution — Collection Operations, Replenishment & Access Management (PA-164.2).)
- CTL-723: one-time/time-bound authenticated credentials; multi-method fallback; access data secured (VS-27.3/VS-91); override authenticated
Cross-references: - links to VS-75 (app), VS-13/VS-126 (loyalty/identity), VS-10/VS-05 (OMS/inventory), VS-27.3 (cyber), VS-91 (privacy), VS-125 (fraud), VS-23 (theft), W4801 (staging), W4805 (override)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Wrong-person-pickup risk**: Credential shared/stolen → wrong person takes the parcel (VS-125/theft VS-23); mitigated by one-time/time-bound + customer-authenticated credentials
- **Access-failure risk**: Code/QR/app failure → customer stranded; mitigated by multi-method + override
- **Privacy risk**: Access/recipient data mishandled (VS-91); mitigated by security & minimization
System Touchpoints: - Locker platform/access-control (W4797/W4807); app (VS-75); loyalty/identity (VS-13/VS-126); OMS/inventory (VS-10/VS-05); cyber (VS-27.3); privacy (VS-91)

steps.activity: Generate the secure access credential (time-limited PIN/QR via app VS-75, or RFID/loyalty-card tap VS-13) tied to the specific compartment + order + customer; deliver via the app/SMS/email; ensure one-time/time-bound use and the customer-authentication binding (links VS-13/VS-126 single-customer-view)

Authenticate the pickup: customer scans/taps/PINs at the locker, the locker validates against the platform, opens the compartment, and confirms pickup → updates the OMS/inventory (VS-10/VS-05) and triggers the fulfillment-complete event; manage multi-method fallback if the primary method fails

Govern the security/privacy: prevent credential sharing/fraud (the wrong person opening a compartment — links VS-125), secure the access data (VS-27.3), and the consent/data for the recipient (VS-91); handle lost/failed access via customer-service override (W4805) with authentication

fields.Trigger: Customer initiates a locker return (VS-32); return-eligible item
fields.Volume: ~1,500–3,000 locker returns/month at maturity (subset of returns volume VS-32)

workflows.name: Returns Drop-Off via Locker & Reverse-Logistics Handoff

Automation Opportunity: - Eligibility auto-check; drop-off auto-confirm → refund-trigger (per policy); retrieval-task auto-routing; mismatch flagging
Controls: - CTL-723 (ensure controlled execution — Collection Operations, Replenishment & Access Management (PA-164.2).)
- CTL-723: eligibility validated; retrieve-then-verify sequencing; refund per policy after verification; mismatch investigated (VS-125)
Cross-references: - links to VS-32 (returns/reverse logistics), VS-05 (inventory), VS-80/VS-101 (refund), VS-23/VS-125 (LP/fraud), VS-13 (CX), W4801 (compartment), W4802 (access)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Return-fraud risk**: Empty/wrong-item drop (VS-125) → refund-before-verification loss; mitigated by retrieve-then-verify-then-refund sequencing where policy requires
- **Compartment-occupancy risk**: Returned items occupying compartments awaiting retrieval → reduced pickup capacity; mitigated by prompt retrieval SLA
- **Eligibility-error risk**: Non-returnable item accepted → policy/Consumer-Act issue; mitigated by eligibility validation
System Touchpoints: - Returns/OMS (VS-32); locker platform (W4807); inventory (VS-05); payment/refund (VS-80/VS-101); LP/fraud (VS-23/VS-125); CX (VS-13)

steps.activity: On a customer-initiated locker return (online/app per VS-32), validate return eligibility (item, condition, policy), assign a compartment, and generate the drop-off access credential (W4802) + return label/instructions; communicate the return window

Customer drops the item into the compartment; the locker confirms drop-off → updates the return/OMS (VS-32), triggers refund/credit per policy, and creates the reverse-logistics pick task; manage the condition/contents verification when the item is retrieved

Retrieve the returned item from the locker, verify contents/condition (vs the claimed return), and hand off to reverse-logistics (VS-32) for restock/RTV/refurbish/disposal; manage mismatch/fraud (empty box, wrong item — links VS-125)

fields.Trigger: Compartment hold-period expiry (profile §8.2 BOPIS hold 5 days); locker at capacity

Automation Opportunity: - Expiry-countdown auto-reminders; auto-reclaim on expiry; auto-cancel & refund; capacity-based routing
Controls: - CTL-723 (ensure controlled execution — Collection Operations, Replenishment & Access Management (PA-164.2).)
- CTL-723: hold-period enforced; reminders before expiry; reclaim-then-refund/restock; abandonment rate tracked
Cross-references: - links to VS-10 (BOPIS/hold policy), VS-05.3/VS-32 (disposition/returns), VS-80/VS-101 (refund), VS-13 (CX/reminders), W4795/W4799 (capacity/priority), W4815 (abandonment KPI)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stuck-compartment risk**: Abandoned items occupying compartments → capacity loss; mitigated by the hold-period reclaim
- **Refund-leakage risk**: Refunding abandoned items without recovering the stock; mitigated by reclaim-then-restock sequencing
- **Customer-disappointment risk**: Auto-cancel of a still-wanted order; mitigated by reminders before expiry
System Touchpoints: - Locker platform (W4807); OMS/BOPIS (VS-10); inventory/disposition (VS-05.3/VS-32); payment/refund (VS-80/VS-101); CX (VS-13); analytics (W4815)
Time Estimate: - ~per expiry reclaim 2–5 min; ~continuous capacity monitoring absorbed

steps.activity: Monitor compartment occupancy and the hold-period countdown; send reminders to customers as the hold approaches expiry (profile §8.2 5-day hold → auto-cancel & refund after); manage capacity alerts when a locker bank nears full

On expiry, reclaim the compartment: remove the uncollected order, process the auto-cancel & refund per BOPIS policy (VS-10), and return the item to sellable stock or to the returns/disposition chain (VS-05.3/VS-32); free the compartment for new orders

Manage overflow: when a bank is at capacity, route new BOPIS to the counter (VS-10) or an adjacent locker, manage 3P-parcel compartment priority (W4799), and tune compartment mix (W4795) to reduce future overflow; track abandonment rate as a KPI (W4815)

fields.Trigger: Order ready (W4801); pickup event; customer needs help

workflows.name: Customer Pickup Journey, Notifications & Support Escalation

Automation Opportunity: - Journey auto-notifications; in-app wayfinding; help-button → store-team alert; authenticated override; NPS auto-survey
Controls: - CTL-723 (ensure controlled execution — Collection Operations, Replenishment & Access Management (PA-164.2).)
- CTL-723: pickup journey with notifications + wayfinding; support SLA (VS-13.1); overrides authenticated; CX feedback captured
Cross-references: - links to VS-13.1 (contact center/SLA), VS-75 (app), VS-14 (signage), VS-07 (store assist), VS-32 (returns), VS-133 (improvement), W4802 (access/override), W4815 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stranded-customer risk**: Pickup failure with no fast resolution → churn + bad CX; mitigated by multi-channel support + on-site assist + override
- **Wrong-item/damage risk**: Customer opens to find wrong/damaged item; mitigated by fast CX resolution + VS-32 returns
- **Friction-abandonment risk**: Confusing journey → order abandoned (W4804); mitigated by journey design + reminders
System Touchpoints: - CX/contact-center (VS-13.1); app/notifications (VS-75); signage (VS-14); store ops (VS-07); locker platform (W4807); analytics (W4815)
Time Estimate: - ~per pickup automated; ~per support ticket per CX SLA (VS-13.1)

steps.activity: Manage the customer pickup journey: ready-notification (app/SMS/email per VS-75), access-code/QR delivery (W4802), in-app locker location/wayfinding (VS-14 signage), the pickup (open compartment → confirm), and the thank-you/cross-sell; track pickup-success and time-to-pickup

Provide support for pickup friction: code-not-working, compartment-won't-open, wrong-item, item-damaged, lost-code — via app chat/call-center (VS-13.1 W258/W259) or an on-site help button → store-team assist or authenticated override (W4802); resolve within SLA (VS-13.1 W597)
Capture the locker-channel CX feedback/NPS (VS-13), drive cross-sell during pickup (basket link W4793), and feed recurring issues to improvement (VS-133) and analytics (W4815)

fields.Trigger: Bulky BOPIS order (lumber/tile/appliance per profile §6.2); refrigerated/sensitive item
fields.Volume: ~20–30% of BOPIS orders (bulky items dominate BuildRight's basket)

Automation Opportunity: - Oversize eligibility auto-check; refrigerated-hold auto-shorten + reminders; BMS-temperature auto-alert (VS-138)
Controls: - CTL-723 (ensure controlled execution — Collection Operations, Replenishment & Access Management (PA-164.2).)
- CTL-723: oversize eligibility rules + assist; refrigerated compartments monitored with shorter hold; spoilage dispositioned (VS-05.3)
Cross-references: - links to VS-10 (OMS/BOPIS), VS-06.3 (delivery fallback), VS-138 (BMS/refrigeration), VS-05.3 (disposition), VS-145 (live-goods pattern), W4801 (staging), W4805 (journey)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Oversize-mismatch risk**: Bulky item forced into undersized compartment or unsafe self-collect → damage/injury; mitigated by eligibility rules and assist
- **Spoilage risk**: Refrigerated items exceeding the shorter hold → write-off; mitigated by shorter hold + reminders + disposition (VS-05.3)
- **Safety risk**: Customer handling a heavy/bulky parcel without assist; mitigated by assist protocol
System Touchpoints: - OMS (VS-10); locker platform (W4807); facilities/BMS (VS-138); inventory/disposition (VS-05.3); live-goods/garden (VS-145); CX (VS-13)
Time Estimate: - ~per order absorbed in W4801 staging; ~continuous monitoring for refrigerated

steps.activity: For oversize/bulky orders (lumber packs, cement/tile, appliances, furniture), determine locker-eligibility vs counter/curbside (W4758-style) fallback: only assign if an oversize compartment fits and is safe to self-collect; otherwise route to counter/curbside pickup (VS-10) or delivery (VS-06.3)

For refrigerated/temperature-sensitive items (if offered — e.g., certain garden/live-adjacent or specialty), use refrigerated locker compartments, manage the temperature monitoring (VS-138 BMS, VS-145 live-goods pattern), the shorter hold-period, and the spoilage/disposition if uncollected (VS-05.3)

Communicate clearly to the customer: oversize handling (e.g., forklift/assist at pickup vs self-service), refrigerated-item urgency, and any safety/weight notes; manage the customer-experience distinct from standard locker pickup (W4805)

workflows.name: ERP / Ecommerce / OMS / Loyalty Real-Time Integration Operations

Automation Opportunity: - Event-streaming reliability tooling; desync auto-detection & repair; cyber-monitoring (VS-27.3); integration-health dashboard
Controls: - CTL-723 (ensure controlled execution — Collection Operations, Replenishment & Access Management (PA-164.2).)
- CTL-723: real-time integration with <30s latency; locker/IoT segmented & secured (VS-27.3); customer data classified (VS-91); vendor under TPRM (VS-161)
Cross-references: - links to VS-27/VS-113 (integration), VS-10 (OMS), VS-05 (inventory), VS-13/VS-126 (loyalty/CDP), VS-75 (app), VS-27.3 (cyber), VS-91 (privacy), VS-161 (TPRM), W4808 (recon)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Desync risk**: Locker and OMS out of sync → wrong status/stranded order/phantom inventory (VS-05 accuracy); mitigated by reliable event-streaming and reconciliation (W4808)
- **Cyber/privacy risk**: IoT/customer-data compromise (VS-27.3/VS-91); mitigated by segmentation + DPA + TPRM
- **Latency risk**: Slow status updates → poor CX; mitigated by the <30s latency target
System Touchpoints: - IT/integration (VS-27/VS-113); ecommerce/OMS (VS-10); inventory (VS-05); loyalty/CDP (VS-13/VS-126); app (VS-75); cyber (VS-27.3); privacy (VS-91); TPRM (VS-161)
Time Estimate: - ~continuous platform ops absorbed in IT staffing

steps.activity: Operate the real-time integration: locker ↔ OMS (order/compartment/pickup status VS-10), ↔ inventory (VS-05 — pickup decrements stock, returns increments/reverse), ↔ loyalty/CRM (VS-13/VS-126 — customer identity, points, NPS), ↔ app/notifications (VS-75), and ↔ 3P-carrier APIs (W4799); manage event-streaming reliability (<30s latency per POS-013 pattern)

Manage cybersecurity & data (VS-27.3/VS-91): the locker platform is an IoT/customer-data system — network segmentation, API security, access-data protection, the recipient/customer PII classification, retention (VS-88), and breach readiness; manage the vendor as TPRM/IoT risk (VS-161)

Monitor integration health, handle exceptions (desync between locker and OMS, failed status updates, duplicate events), and feed integration-quality metrics to analytics (W4815) and improvement (VS-133); manage change/releases per VS-27.1

fields.Owner: Locker Program Manager / Store Ops (VS-07) / Finance
fields.Trigger: Daily close (VS-07); inventory cycle (VS-05); exception alert

workflows.name: Daily Locker Reconciliation, Inventory Accuracy & Exception Handling

Automation Opportunity: - Auto state-recon (physical vs platform vs OMS); variance auto-flag; sensor-fault diagnostics; exception dashboard
Controls: - CTL-723: daily recon to ≥97% accuracy; exceptions triaged & resolved; variances investigated (LP VS-23); root-cause fed to improvement
Cross-references: - links to VS-05 (inventory/accuracy), VS-10 (OMS), VS-23 (LP/shrink), VS-101/VS-32 (refund/returns), VS-133 (improvement), W4807 (integration), W4815 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Inventory-accuracy risk**: Locker desync eroding the ≥97% target (profile §6.3); mitigated by daily recon
- **Shrinkage risk**: Unexplained missing items → shrink (VS-23); mitigated by LP investigation
- **Customer-loss risk**: Item not found at pickup → service failure + refund loss; mitigated by fast resolution + VS-101 refund
System Touchpoints: - Inventory (VS-05); locker platform (W4807); OMS (VS-10); LP (VS-23); analytics (W4815); finance/refund (VS-101/VS-32)

steps.activity: Reconcile daily: physical compartment state (occupied/empty) vs locker-platform state vs OMS/inventory state (VS-10/VS-05); investigate variances (phantom-occupied, phantom-empty, missing item) and resolve to maintain ≥97% inventory-accuracy target (profile §6.3)

Handle exceptions: stuck-locked compartment, failed-open, sensor fault, mis-pick, item-not-found, suspected theft (VS-23) — with documented triage and resolution; manage the customer impact (refund/replacement per VS-101/VS-32) for any loss
Feed variance/exception data to analytics (W4815), inventory accuracy (VS-05), and LP/theft investigation (VS-23); drive root-cause improvement (VS-133) on recurring exceptions
